description: Reserved submission contract; execution is currently unavailable and returns submission_unavailable without filing. Shared durable reservation and unknown-outcome reconciliation across dashboard, checkout and cron are prerequisites. Preparation and status are handled by get_text_registration and save_text_registration_details. Saving corrected details does not resubmit existing rejected provider objects: operator reconciliation is required. Another entry point or a new paid registration would duplicate the filing. It accepts no tax identifiers, credentials, file contents or legal attestations. Owner membership and billing:write required.
name: submit_text_registration
title: Text Registration Submission Availability
